name: leafcare
description: LeafCare — camera-based plant identification and watering reminders. Expo app + Next.js API.

scripts.docs:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['README.md','AGENTS.md','CONTRIBUTING.md','docs/overview.md','docs/requirements.md','docs/architecture.md','docs/specification.md','docs/database.md','docs/api.md','docs/security.md','docs/ui-ux.md','docs/plan.md','docs/tasks.md','docs/testing.md','docs/deployment.md','docs/troubleshooting.md','docs/changelog.md']; const missing=files.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f)); if(missing.length){console.error('Missing:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1)} console.log('Docs present: '+files.length+' files')"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @leafcare/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @leafcare/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @leafcare/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @leafcare/api && npm run lint --workspace @leafcare/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:mobile
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run check:secrets
